storm = very bad weather with strong wind, rain or snow
blizzard = a severe snowstorm with strong wind
heatwave = several very hot days in a row
frost = ice that forms on surfaces when it is very cold
freezing = below 0°C; extremely cold
mild = not very hot and not very cold
boiling = informal: extremely hot weather
breeze = a light, pleasant wind
gale = a very strong wind
rainbow = an arc of colours in the sky after rain
sunshine = light and heat from the sun
shade = a cooler place where the sun does not shine
puddle = a small pool of water on the ground after rain
mud = wet, soft earth
soil = the top layer of earth in which plants grow
rock = hard natural stone in the ground or mountains
pebble = a small, smooth stone, often on a beach
sand = very small grains of rock, as on a beach
forest = a large area of trees
woods = a smaller area of trees, often near a town
